siteSettings.about_content: Sakthi Solutions provides digital signage, interactive kiosks, feedback solutions and IT consulting for hospitality, retail and corporate sectors. The company was formed in the year 2014 by a team with vast experience of 25+ years in sales - Retail, Packaging, industrial automation and hospitality.
siteSettings.mission: To provide complete hardware, digital signage and IT consulting end-to-end solutions for hospitality, retail and corporate sectors, enabling businesses to operate efficiently with the right technology.
siteSettings.vision: To be the most trusted technology partner for digital signage and IT solutions, known for prompt service, reliable partnerships and innovative solutions.
